The planned study builds on previously announced positive topline results from an investigator-sponsored trial (IST) conducted at Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center (MSK) in patients with moderate-to-severe irEC, in which 80% of participants achieved an immunosuppressive-free clinical response at Day 15, following treatment with SER-155.

• The planned next study builds on encouraging topline results from the open-label IST (NCT06801067) conducted at MSK evaluating SER-155 as a potential treatment in irEC, which Seres reported in July.
